Swash plate axial piston tandem pumps for mobile machinery, with multiple control options and optional PTO.
面向 20–28 吨级履带挖掘机，同时适用于混凝土设备、钻机等开式液压回路。
For 20–28 tonne crawler excavators and other open-circuit applications, including concrete equipment and drilling rigs.
覆盖多种排量配置的工程机械双泵系列，为不同设备提供液压动力选型。
A tandem pump family with multiple displacement options for construction equipment.
面向重型设备的串联双泵系列，提供产品尺寸、液压回路及配件选型资料。
Tandem pumps for heavy machinery, supported by dimensional, circuit and component documentation.
K3V 系列大排量双泵，适用于需要较大液压动力的设备选型。
A large-displacement tandem pump in the K3V family for demanding hydraulic applications.
斜盘式轴向柱塞单泵，提供多种规格和控制配置，服务工业与工程机械应用。
Swash plate axial piston single pumps in multiple sizes and control configurations for industrial and mobile applications.

The K7V family for mobile machinery, with cutaway views, specifications and installation dimensions.

Six sizes—63, 112, 180, 280, 180DT and 280DT—for industrial hydraulics including injection molding, presses and marine deck machinery.
紧凑型液压泵系列，样本包含泵体结构、液压回路与性能参数。
A compact hydraulic pump family with structural, hydraulic circuit and performance documentation.

An integrated swash plate piston motor and two-stage planetary reducer for excavator swing applications.
将柱塞马达与减速机构集成，提供回转装置结构、性能及安装尺寸资料。
Integrated piston motor and reducer assemblies, supported by structural, performance and installation documentation.
集成斜盘式柱塞马达与行星减速机构，服务履带式设备行走驱动。

Travel drives combining piston motors with reduction gearing for a range of tracked machines.

HMC variable-displacement two-speed and HMB fixed-displacement single-speed radial piston motors for industrial and marine applications.

desc: 泵、马达与减速机构配件，结合爆炸图、零件编号和设备信息完成匹配。
Pump, motor and reduction gear components matched using exploded views, part references and machine information.
FP20V 工业用斜盘式轴向柱塞泵，提供恒压、负载敏感及恒功率控制方式。样本列有装载机、混凝土设备、泵站与工业机械应用，可选通轴驱动配置。

FP20V swash plate axial piston pumps for industrial applications, with pressure, load-sensing and horsepower control options. Documented applications include wheel loaders, concrete equipment, pump units and industrial machinery; through-drive configurations are optional.
用于顶锤式液压钻机凿岩机进给系统的 FFD 系列马达。样本列示变排量两速结构，并配置平衡阀和缓冲溢流阀以减小停机冲击。

FFD feed motors for drifter feed systems in top-hammer hydraulic drilling rigs. The brochure describes a variable-displacement two-speed design with a counterbalance valve and shockless relief valve to reduce stopping impact.
面向工业压力机应用的 FP3VG 斜盘式柱塞泵。样本提供流量、压力和功率等多种控制方式，并列有辅助齿轮泵选装能力。
FP3VG swash plate piston pumps for industrial press applications. The brochure lists flow, pressure and horsepower control options, together with optional auxiliary gear-pump mounting.
用于工业压力机等设备的 FPZ / FPX 轴向柱塞泵系列。总册同时收录面向挤出机应用的 FPZ Rotas 电液伺服控制机型，配置需按具体工况确认。

FPZ / FPX axial piston pumps for industrial presses and related equipment. The brochure also includes the FPZ Rotas electro-hydraulic servo-controlled variant for extruder applications; configurations require application-specific confirmation.
由 FP20V 泵与伺服电机组成的 ES SERVO 动力方案。通过伺服电机变速调节所需流量，样本列有钢铁工业应用，以及卸荷时停机或低速运行的控制方式。

ES SERVO combines an FP20V pump with a servo motor. Variable-speed control supplies hydraulic flow on demand; the brochure lists steel-industry applications and stopped or low-speed operation during unloading.
用于混凝土设备、叉车等应用的 EPPR 插装式控制阀。样本列示紧凑结构、可选滤网、快速响应和低泄漏特性。
EPPR cartridge-type control valves for applications including concrete equipment and forklifts. The brochure lists a compact design, optional screen filter, fast response and low leakage.
面向叉车应用的 MCV 多路控制阀，采用开中心系统和分片式工作元件。提供并联或并联加串联回路形式，样本列示最高工作压力为 25 MPa。

MCV control valves for forklift applications, with an open-center system and sectional work elements. Parallel and parallel-plus-tandem circuits are listed, with a maximum operating pressure of 25 MPa.
船用舵机系列，包含电液舵机与电机控制舵机。总册列示舵机扭矩覆盖 33–1030 ton·m；具体控制方案、系统配置与船型要求需结合项目确认。

Marine steering gear covering electro-hydraulic and motor-control configurations. The brochure lists a steering-torque range of 33–1030 ton·m; controls, system configuration and vessel requirements require project-specific confirmation.
面向船舶锚泊与系泊作业的甲板机械系列，覆盖电液、电动和电液自容式配置。可结合船型、操控方式及安装要求选型，具体功能需按配置确认。

Deck machinery for marine anchoring and mooring, including electro-hydraulic, electric and electro-hydraulic self-contained configurations. Selection depends on vessel, controls and installation requirements; features vary by configuration.

An assembly line for TRG07, TRG11, TRG14 and TRG20 slewing reducers, combining cover assembly, adhesive dispensing, vision inspection and screw tightening with a manual accessories station.
